outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: Minor formatting differences (bulleting, capitalization) are not important.

Critical issues: (1) The agent did not provide the required “All Reviews” summary. DOM evidence shows the page section includes “Recent Reviews” and “English Reviews” lines, but the task explicitly requires using “All Reviews” rather than other review scopes. The agent output substitutes “ENGLISH REVIEWS: Overwhelmingly Positive (173,694)” and also omits the displayed percentage and explanatory text that appears with that line in the DOM (“98% of the 173,694 user reviews for this game are positive.”). This fails a hard constraint and leaves the user without the requested All Reviews label/percentage/count. (2) System Requirements: the agent correctly listed the OS headings shown (“Windows” and “SteamOS + Linux”) and correctly captured Windows minimum storage (“Storage: 8 GB available space”). However, it did not report the minimum Storage requirement for SteamOS + Linux; it states it was not visible in the current DOM state. Regardless of whether it was difficult to access, the user asked for the storage requirement for each OS heading, and the delivered output is missing one required OS’s storage value.

What was completed correctly: The agent was on the correct Steam page for Portal 2 (app/620) and correctly reported Release Date (18 Apr, 2011), Developer (Valve), and Publisher (Valve). It also respected constraints by not signing in or initiating any purchase/cart/wishlist actions.

Overall outcome: Because the required “All Reviews” summary was not captured (and was replaced with a different review scope and incomplete components) and one OS’s minimum Storage requirement was not provided, the agent did not deliver all of the requested product metadata. From an average user’s perspective, the task is incomplete.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted accurate, on-page metadata from the Steam store listing for Portal 2: release date/developer/publisher, the exact displayed “All Reviews” summary (label + sentiment + percent + count), and the System Requirements OS headings with each OS’s minimum Storage line. A reasonable user would be flexible on minor formatting, but not flexible on substituting a different reviews line for “All Reviews” or omitting required Storage values when they are available on the page.
